remarks:
This country home sits on 4 acres and borders Bully Hill State Forest in Almond NY, Allegany County. 

Discover the privacy of this A-frame country home nestled on 4.2 wooded acres on a quiet paved town road. As the last home before Bully Hill State Forest, this property offers an exceptional setting surrounded by nature with a stream flowing along the rear boundary.

The 3-bedroom home features a warm and inviting interior with tongue-and-groove wood ceilings, exposed beams, and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace that serves as the focal point of the living room. The main level includes a spacious bedroom, full bathroom, comfortable living area, and a kitchen with dining space and an eat-in counter. A spiral staircase leads to the second floor where you'll find two additional bedrooms overlooking the wooded surroundings.

The home is built on a solid block foundation with a basement, providing laundry hookups and additional storage space. A newer 24 x 20 two-car garage with a concrete floor offers ample room for vehicles, tools, and outdoor equipment.

Outside, enjoy over 800 feet of road frontage, hardwoods, and a stream bordering the back of the property. Step directly from your backyard into Bully Hill State Forest, with several additional State Forests offering thousands of acres of public land located within five miles for hunting, hiking, snowmobiling, and year-round outdoor recreation.

Conveniently located just minutes from Interstate 86 and the City of Hornell, this property combines the privacy of a secluded country setting with easy access to everyday amenities. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, seasonal getaway, or recreational retreat, this property offers an outstanding opportunity in the heart of the Southern Tier.
